source_supported_not_independently_logge.gmm: train embeddings, full covariance, n_init=10, random_state=0
source_supported_not_independently_logge.noise: clipped additive Cauchy, resampled on access for training and evaluation
source_supported_not_independently_logge.fashion_heavy_evaluation: epoch 1, every 10, epoch 20, final, and improved post-warmup test reconstruction
source_supported_not_independently_logge.selection: after epoch 25: MNIST/Fashion max refit accuracy, reporting native ACC/ARI/NMI; MRI min test reconstruction, reporting refit Sil/DB
